results.name: Semoa
results.description:
Founded in 2016, SEMOA operates across 14 African countries with a mission to add value to people's daily lives. SEMOA is a fintech company whose solutions focus on two main pillars: the digitalization of banking services and the streamlining of transactions.
As a software publisher, SEMOA offers white-label APIs and SaaS tools designed to address the challenges of financial inclusion in Africa by pushing the boundaries of traditional banking systems.
To digitalize transactions, SEMOA provides an infrastructure that facilitates both inbound and outbound payments (including Mobile Money, credit cards, wallets, etc.).
results.short_description: Digitalization of banking services, mobile payments (API & SaaS)

results.name: Solimi (Gnim)
results.description: Solimi is an innovative fintech platform that aims to make digital financial services accessible to everyone without requiring a traditional bank account. The platform offers a comprehensive solution centered around the “Gnim” prepaid Visa card and an intuitive mobile app, allowing users to manage their expenses, make secure online purchases, and withdraw cash at ATMs (including those at Orabank). By facilitating top-ups via local mobile money services (Tmoney and Flooz), Solimi establishes itself as an essential bridge to a “cashless” economy, offering both individuals and businesses (for payroll and travel expense management) greater financial autonomy and enhanced security for all their domestic and international transactions.
results.short_description: Personal financial management app with instant virtual Visa card

results.name: MiaPay
results.description: MiaPay is a startup specializing in secure digital payments via Mobile Money and credit/debit cards. Its mobile app allows users to make quick transactions (in-store purchases, taxi fares, money transfers).
results.short_description: Payment application combining mobile money and bank cards

results.name: Ego Transfer
results.description: Ego Transfer is an innovative fintech company specializing in the interoperability of mobile payment services. Founded to break down barriers between different operators, the platform primarily enables users to make seamless money transfers between competing networks, including from T-Money to Flooz and vice versa. Beyond cross-network transfers, eGo Transfer also facilitates the receipt of international funds (such as via Ria) directly into a local mobile money account. Recognized for its impact on financial inclusion in Togo, this solution caters to both individuals and merchants by offering an intuitive app that simplifies the day-to-day management of digital transactions without relying on a single telecom operator.
results.short_description: Money transfer platform and financial services

results.name: PayGate
results.description: PayGate Global is a leading fintech platform specializing in the aggregation of online payment solutions for e-commerce merchants and businesses. It stands out for its ability to simplify digital payment processing by enabling businesses to accept mobile money payments (including T-Money and Flooz) through a single interface and an easy-to-integrate API. Designed to overcome the technical and administrative barriers associated with electronic payments, PayGate Global offers a secure dashboard for real-time transaction tracking and facilitates fund withdrawals. By serving as a bridge between mobile operators and sales platforms (websites or apps), it plays a leading role in accelerating e-commerce and financial inclusion in Togo.

results.name: Fintou
results.description: Fintou is a pioneering fintech platform specializing in crowdfunding and online fundraising. Driven by the vision of “Finance for All,” it enables entrepreneurs, cultural creators, and organizations to mobilize support from their communities to bring a wide range of projects to life, from social entrepreneurship to personal events (weddings, birthdays). Fintou stands out for its versatility, offering not only crowdfunding tools but also solutions for online ticketing, secure voting, and product sales via QR codes. By integrating mobile money and credit card payments, the platform breaks down traditional barriers to financing in Africa, offering a flexible and transparent alternative that transforms contributors into true project partners.

results.name: Zepargn
results.description: Zepargn is an innovative fintech solution dedicated to digitizing savings and managing microfinance. The platform positions itself as an accessible financial planning tool, enabling users to build up savings gradually and securely to fund specific projects or cover unexpected expenses. Leveraging the flexibility of mobile money services (T-Money and Flooz), Zepargn breaks down barriers to financial inclusion by offering a modern alternative to traditional tontines and conventional savings accounts. Thanks to an intuitive interface and real-time tracking mechanisms, it encourages budget discipline and financial autonomy, both for individuals and for small groups looking to digitize their fundraising efforts.
results.short_description: Savings management and financial progress tracking

results.name: Clinicaa
results.description: Clinicaa is an ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) software platform specifically designed for the integrated management of healthcare facilities. Developed to modernize the patient care journey, it offers a comprehensive suite of tools covering both clinical and financial aspects: from online appointment scheduling and electronic health record management to billing, pharmacy tracking, and accounting. By centralizing medical and administrative data, Clinicaa enables hospitals, clinics, and health centers to optimize operational efficiency, reduce data entry errors, and improve the quality of patient care through better coordination of medical teams. Its reporting and analytics features make it a strategic tool for managing the performance of modern healthcare facilities.
results.short_description: Digitalization of health structures (hospital management, digital health record)

results.name: Kondjigbalè
results.description: Kondjigbalé is an innovative digital platform designed to centralize and secure health data. Conceived as a smart digital health record, it allows patients to keep a complete history of their appointments, biomedical tests, and prescriptions in one place, accessible via a QR code or a unique identifier. Beyond simple storage, Kondjigbalé facilitates interaction between users and healthcare providers by offering online appointment scheduling, telemedicine, and medication reminder services. By digitizing the care pathway, this solution aims to reduce medical errors caused by a lack of information and improve the efficiency of emergency care, thereby establishing itself as a pillar of modern e-health in Togo
